reason: The proposed get_order_details call retrieves information about the authenticated user's own order (#W4923227). This is a read-only operation within the permitted scope (provide information about user's orders). The user has been properly authenticated via email lookup. No explicit user confirmation is required for information retrieval—only for database-updating actions (cancel, modify, return, exchange). The call complies with the one-tool-at-a-time rule and does not violate any policy requirements.
policy_references: provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products
At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation
